name: ev_hurkacz
sql: select event_id, home, away, start_at, status, league, tier, bookmaker_ids, first_seen, last_seen from ten287_rec.events where home ilike '%hurkacz%' or away ilike '%hurkacz%' or home ilike '%damm%' or away ilike '%damm%' order by start_at

name: ticks_hurkacz
sql: select t.book, t.event_id, count(*) n, min(t.book_updated_at) first_at, max(t.book_updated_at) last_at, count(*) filter (where t.event_status='pending') pending from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) where e.home ilike '%hurkacz%' or e.away ilike '%hurkacz%' group by 1,2

name: raw_ticks_hurkacz
sql: select t.book, t.event_id, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status, t.src from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) where e.home ilike '%hurkacz%' or e.away ilike '%hurkacz%' order by t.book, t.book_updated_at limit 200

name: rpc_hurkacz
sql: select e from jsonb_array_elements(public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days')->'events') e where e->>'home' ilike '%hurkacz%' or e->>'away' ilike '%hurkacz%'

name: tier_counts
sql: select coalesce(tier,'(null)') tier, count(*) events, count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from ten287_rec.ticks t where t.event_id=e.event_id)) with_ticks from ten287_rec.events e where start_at > now() - interval '2 days' group by 1

name: null_tier_atp_like
sql: select event_id, home, away, league, start_at from ten287_rec.events where tier is null and start_at > now() - interval '2 days' and (league ilike '%ATP%' or league ilike '%Chengdu%' or league ilike '%Hangzhou%' or league ilike '%Laver%') order by start_at limit 40

name: leagues_recent
sql: select league, tier, count(*) from ten287_rec.events where start_at > now() - interval '2 days' group by 1,2 order by 3 desc limit 60
